feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 15 September 2026 10:00pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 15 September 2026 at 10:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Locally strong winds at first.


##Synopsis##

Complex low developing near Greenland, as another low moves eastwards into Scandinavia. Transient ridge of high pressure builds into Wednesday for a time.


##Wind##

West or northwest 4 or 5, occasionally 6 until tomorrow morning, then decreasing mainly 4 for a time late morning until late afternoon. Then increasing 5 or 6 late tomorrow evening.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming slight late tomorrow morning until late evening.


##Weather##

Scattered showers, becoming isolated overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest, veering west, 5 or 6, occasionally 7 for a time overnight into Thursday and at times during the day on Thursday.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming moderate, occasionally rough for a time in the east of the area overnight into Thursday.


##Weather##

Occasional rain, turning heavy at times, clearing to isolated showers later in the night into Thursday.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain or showers.
